subject: Precision: renewal terms — price shelter + operational burst plan
messages:
From: Taylor Morgan <taylor.morgan@precision.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal prep — upcoming term + burst needs

Ben / Monica,

We’re starting renewal planning for Precision — our FY27 cloud budget is set but we have a few variables: an expected 30% product usage uptick in November (ML retrain cycle) and a short 8–10 week surge window in Q1. We’d like to understand options to keep unit pricing stable while adding a temporary burst allowance and an upsell path if the November uptick becomes permanent.

Key asks:
- Is a temporary price hold possible while we commit to a modest uplift?
- Can we get a one-time pool of burst tokens (or credits) that don’t move the committed band?
- Timeline: need a commercial outline for procurement by Sep 10.

Attached is our standard PO template for procurement. Happy to hop on a quick call next week.

Thanks,
Taylor
Taylor Morgan
Head of Cloud Ops, Precision AI
T: +1 415 555 0191

Attachment: Precision_PO_Template.docx (docx)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Morgan <taylor.morgan@precision.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal prep — upcoming term + burst needs

Taylor — thanks for the clear asks. I pulled together two commercial paths that we commonly use for this pattern and one experimental option we can pilot:

1) Price Shelter + Conditional Commit Uplift (recommended)
  - 6-month price shelter (holds current unit price for burst window) conditioned on a 15% committed uplift for 12 months (can be phased).
  - One-time burst credit: 500k token credit usable during surge; billing only applies beyond credit.

2) Short-term Retainer + Paygo Burst
  - Smaller uplift to committed band + discounted retainer covering baseline surge weeks; burst billed at reduced overage rate.

3) Pilot: Operational Burst Pool (experimental)
  - We reserve capacity in a burst pool for 8–10 weeks with fixed per-week cost; ideal if you need guaranteed headroom.

I attached a concise proposal and a draft term sheet for procurement to review — includes counters and doc signing link. If this looks directionally right I can loop in Sales Ops to finalize pricing grid and get legal to prepare the amendment.

Next steps: I’ll schedule a 30-min call tomorrow morning; if procurement needs the official term sheet before the call I can push it immediately.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 650 555 0123

Attachments: Precision_Renewal_Proposal_Q4_2026.pdf; Precision_Term_Sheet_Q4_2026.xlsx
From: Taylor Morgan <taylor.morgan@precision.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@precision.ai
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal prep — upcoming term + burst needs

Ben,

Thanks — the Price Shelter + Conditional Commit looks closest to what procurement will accept. A couple of clarifications that procurement flagged:
- The 6-month shelter should guarantee no unit price increases for any new model variants we onboard during the shelter window.
- Burst credit: need it expressed as a token/GB equivalence and appear on the invoice as a line item.
- We prefer a 90-day payment term if possible; standard PO will go through finance for approval.

Procurement attached our PO template again. Can you have a legal/commercial confirmation that the shelter applies to model variants introduced during the window? Also confirm how the 500k token credit maps to embeddings vs. generation tokens (we use both).

—Taylor
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Morgan <taylor.morgan@precision.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal prep — upcoming term + burst needs

Taylor — appreciate the specifics. Quick commercial confirmation from Redwood: we can do the Price Shelter with the items you requested subject to a committed uplift and a couple of production guardrails. Proposed term highlights: 

- Price Shelter: 6 months starting on contract effective date. Shelter applies to all model variants that are "Redwood-verified" and onboarded to your account during the shelter window (we will list covered families in the amendment).
- Commit uplift: 15% increase to baseline committed tokens for 12 months. Can be phased 8%/7% over two quarters if preferred.
- Burst credit: 500,000 tokens split 60/40 (generation/embedding) unless you specify different split. Credit line item will appear on invoices and expire at the end of the shelter window.
- Payment term: 90 days OK for this account pending finance sign-off.

I’ve created a pricing grid in the attached term sheet and annotated operational constraints (KV cache sizing and expected latency during peak). If you want the pilot operational-burst pool we can include a weekly reservation price instead of a token credit — that’s typically higher but guarantees capacity.

Ben — request finance approval on the 90-day payment term and conditional commit.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Precision_Term_Sheet_Q4_2026.xlsx
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Taylor Morgan <taylor.morgan@precision.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 15:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal prep — upcoming term + burst needs

Stephanie / Ben — finance reviewed the commercial and supports the Price Shelter approach with the following conditions:

1) Price hold is approved if the 15% commit uplift is executed and invoiced across the first two quarters of the 12-month uplift period.
2) Burst credit accepted; however we need a one-time adjustment clause: if usage after the shelter exceeds committed + burst by more than 40% for two consecutive months, Redwood reserves the right to renegotiate overage rate (this protects cost if the customer permanently scales far beyond expectations).
3) 90-day net is acceptable for Precision AI provided we receive a signed PO within 14 days of DocuSign completion.

Ben — can you present these as an amendment bullet list to procurement and confirm Taylor is ok with the overage protection? If so, I’ll approve final numbers for the amendment.

Thanks,
David Kim
Director, Commercial Finance, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Morgan <taylor.morgan@precision.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, procurement@precision.ai
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2026 16:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal prep — upcoming term + burst needs

Taylor — thanks for the quick turn. Attached is the final term sheet and the DocuSign envelope for the amendment. Key bullets we agreed to:
- 6-month Price Shelter (applies to Redwood-verified variants onboarded during window).
- 15% committed uplift for 12 months (phased option available).
- One-time 500,000 token burst credit, 60/40 split (generation/embedding), line-item on invoice.
- Overage protection clause: if usage > committed + burst by 40% for two consecutive months, Redwood and Precision will revisit overage rates (protects both parties).
- 90-day payment term contingent on signed PO within 14 days.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/ABC123-Precision-Termsheet
Attachments: Precision_Term_Sheet_Q4_2026.xlsx; Precision_Renewal_Proposal_Q4_2026.pdf

If you sign, we’ll route to legal and Sales Ops will schedule onboarding for the burst window. Happy to answer any remaining questions on the call early next week.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 650 555 0123
